usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the current configuration of a specific Gotify push notification endpoint by name, including its server URL, enabled/disabled state, and optional comment. Requires either Mapping.Modify or Mapping.Audit privilege on /mapping/notifications. The response includes a digest field — capture it before calling an update operation to guard against concurrent configuration changes.
tips: The returned 'digest' value should be passed to the corresponding update operation to prevent overwriting concurrent changes.
If 'disable' is absent from the response, the endpoint is enabled (default is false/not disabled).
Endpoint names follow the pve-configid format: alphanumeric and hyphens, no spaces or special characters.
